---
title: "Policies"
---

These are the authoritative, standalone policy documents for the RIPLRT Institute, provided as **rendered web pages** (not downloads), so they're searchable and always show the current version. They expand the working summaries in the chapters. Where a policy and a chapter summary differ, **the policy governs**; where a policy and institutional/sponsor/legal requirements differ, **those govern**.

| Policy | Summary chapter | Read |

| Data Governance | Ch. 11 | [Open »](data-governance.qmd) |
| Responsible AI Use | Ch. 13 | [Open »](responsible-ai-use.qmd) |
| Code of Conduct | (also repo root) | [Open »](code-of-conduct.qmd) |

The Code of Conduct page mirrors the authoritative `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` at the repository root; if the two ever differ, the root file governs.
